integrity: Original claims and their limitations are distinguished from published sequence values and known deficient-by-four formulas; all verification is same-model only.
scientific_limitations: Classification applies to n=2^a p with a>=2 and odd p prime when the odd aliquot quotient has at most two prime factors. The valuation/parity obstruction holds for all fixed points of this shape. The family requires two simultaneous primes, with no infinitude conclusion; broader prime support and larger odd aliquot complexity remain open in this work. Some deficient-by-four family shapes are known prior art.
title: Two-adic rigidity and low-prime-complexity classification for the derivative of an aliquot sum
